title: Chronotomi generated-site SEO contract review

contract.routePolicy: extensionless, no trailing slash except root
contract.sitemapPolicy: every intended canonical page exactly once; exclude manage, assets, and redirect-source paths

currentTreeRisks.finding: The current tree has no dist/ directory. package.json declares npm run build, but its scripts/build-site.mjs entry file is absent in the current checkout.
currentTreeRisks.impact: Generated route, robots, and sitemap checks cannot run until the approved build entry exists and produces dist/.

currentTreeRisks.finding: Current watches.json now exposes id, slug, summary, brandSlug, and structured images entries.
currentTreeRisks.impact: The catalog identity contract is covered; the verifier continues to check every structured image src and every canonical watch route.

currentTreeRisks.finding: The baseline catalog repeated the Rolex / 126710GRNR brand-reference pair; the current projected catalog no longer reports that duplicate.
currentTreeRisks.impact: The verifier retains the uniqueness check so future inventory edits cannot silently create competing canonical watch pages.

currentTreeRisks.finding: Current homepage contains brand/filter links but no serialized watch IDs/references or per-watch crawlable links in its initial HTML; watch cards remain created by script.js.
currentTreeRisks.impact: The homepage initial-HTML crawlability checks fail, as intended.

currentTreeRisks.finding: Current pages contain internal href values such as index.html, about.html, privacy.html, terms.html, and logistics.html.
currentTreeRisks.impact: The clean internal-link contract fails until generated/source navigation uses extensionless routes.

currentTreeRisks.finding: Current required static source pages expose the required canonical, OG/Twitter, H1, and parseable JSON-LD signals.
currentTreeRisks.impact: The same assertions will run against every generated route once dist/ exists, preventing build-time metadata regressions.

currentTreeRisks.finding: At least one current catalog image source, assets/santos-de-cartier-wssa0018.jpeg, does not exist locally.
currentTreeRisks.impact: The build must replace or correct the source before a generated watch page can satisfy the local-image contract.

integrationNotes: Run node tests/seo-check.mjs after npm run build; the verifier exits 0 only when the full generated route inventory and source homepage contract pass.
Use node tests/seo-check.mjs --json for CI artifacts and machine-readable failure codes.
The route resolver accepts dist/<route>, dist/<route>/index.html, and dist/<route>.html while requiring canonical URLs to remain extensionless.

Watch route derivation prefers explicit canonicalPath/path/route/canonicalUrl, then /watches/<slug>; a deterministic fallback keeps pre-contract failures actionable but does not waive missing id/slug errors.
The harness checks serialized HTML only and intentionally does not run JavaScript, so homepage watch links must be present in initial HTML.
No production, package, catalog, config, script, template, or asset files are owned by this review.
